newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-DOURTHE SCORES 34 POINTS AS DAX CRUSH EDINBURGH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DOURTHE SCORES 34 POINTS AS DAX CRUSH EDINBURGH.

text.p: French international centre Richard Dourthe contributed 34 points on Sunday as Dax crushed Edinburgh 69-12 in their European Cup Pool A tie.
Dourthe, suspended for two months last season for rough play and warned again in an international against Wales this month, scored three tries and kicked a further 19 points.
Edinburgh had to be content with four penalties to fly-half Duncan Hodge.
The victory allowed Dax, who scored 10 tries in all, to move to the top of their group alongside Welsh side Pontypridd. Dax travel to Bath next Saturday.

"I was under pressure to do well today after being criticised in the Wales match. We needed to score as many points as possible because I feel that Pontypridd, Bath and Dax will all end up with three wins," Dourthe said.
"Now we hope to win the match in Bath so as to play our quarter-final in Dax."
